title: Recovery Grant for Small Businesses and Non-Profit Organisations – Guidelines
summary: This page provides guidelines for the Recovery Grant for Small Businesses and Non-Profit Organisations following eligible severe weather events.
who_can_apply: Must be a Public Company that is not a Non-profit Organisation.
Must be a body corporate under the Body Corporate and Community Management Act 1997.
The total standard hours worked by all employees must be less than the number of standard hours worked by 20 full-time employees (as defined by the Australian Bureau of Statistics).
If a Sole Trader has no employees, they must derive at least 50 per cent of their income from the business.
Must hold an ABN active at the time of the Eligible Disasters.

The business must either be in start-up mode (with the intention of being the applicant's primary source of income at least 50 per cent) or must have been the applicant's primary source of income and would become so again in a relatively short period of time had the Eligible Disasters not occurred.
For separate businesses, they must be independent, separately owned, and registered with their own ABN or relevant registration, and must each be eligible for the grant in their own right.
what_you_need: A copy of a Council Rates Notice for the property impacted by the Eligible Disasters, received up to 12 months prior to the Eligible Disaster.
A copy of the current lease agreement (must confirm the applicant is responsible for meeting the claimed costs).
Other evidence to demonstrate lease of property.
Utility bills (e.g. electricity, gas, water) issued within 6 months prior to the relevant Eligible Disaster.
Rental payment records or a rental ledger issued within 6 months prior to the relevant Eligible Disaster.
Insurance documents in effect or issued within 12 months prior to the relevant Eligible Disaster.
Supplier invoices dated within 3 months prior to the relevant Eligible Disaster.
Evidence of costs incurred that would not ordinarily have been incurred in the absence of the Eligible Disasters, or costs that exceed what would ordinarily have been incurred.
Evidence of replacing lost or damaged stock, where the replacement is essential for immediately resuming operation.
Evidence of leasing temporary premises (for 12 months or less) in the same region or LGA, for the purpose of resuming operation.

faqs.q: What eligible disasters qualify for this grant?
faqs.a: Eligible disasters include Tropical Cyclone Alfred Severe Weather from 3 March 2025, and/or NSW East Coast Severe Weather from 18 May 2025.

faqs.q: What types of organisations are eligible?
faqs.a: Eligibility criteria vary, but include Public Companies that are not Non-profit Organisations, body corporates, Superannuation Funds, and Sole Traders who meet specific income requirements.

faqs.q: How can I prove my expenses or ownership?
faqs.a: Evidence can include Council Rates Notices, current lease agreements, utility bills, rental payment records, insurance documents, and supplier invoices.
